resources.string: Allow the system recognition service to use a network
Change this voice in the existing speech-provider settings. Controls vary by provider.

Background wake listening depends on Android and device power policies. After a system stop, resume it from this page. Unlock the device before using the assistant. This is not a low-power hardware wake engine; device performance and battery use must be tested.

The assistant uses the microphone after an invocation or your action. Hey Zero is a separate, optional foreground listener with a persistent notification; it keeps the microphone and CPU active and can use significant battery. Wake detection and personal samples stay on this device. After waking, audio may go to your chosen STT service, text to the selected model, and replies to the selected TTS service. Enabling the assistant does not automatically enable Hey Zero. You can disable it and remove personalization here.
Echo cancellation may be unavailable. Headphones can reduce accidental interruptions.
Off by default. Invocation, wake listening and native live calls are separate features.

System TTS is the default. Other choices reuse your existing speech providers. Only the selected service is used.
Voices come from the actual engine. Gender is not always provided; use the original voice names and preview them rather than assuming male or female labels.
This engine reports that the selected voice needs a network connection.

Local acoustic-template engine. Record your own phrase before use. This is not speech-to-text, identity verification or neural-network fine-tuning. Test false activations on your device before relying on it.
The acoustic engine matches recorded sound, not a language dictionary. This language labels new recordings; changing app language does not delete or replace existing wake data.
Wake listening paused for another microphone task

This engine chooses pronunciation from reply text and its voice settings; it does not accept an explicit language setting. To force a reading language, select Android TTS or xAI. Your saved language preference is kept.
